<thought>We need to create an ML-ready dataset from the consolidated polymorphs JSON using advanced feature engineering, a 0.2 test split, and normalization. The tool `prepare_tabular_dataset` will generate the training and test files plus a metadata JSON. After running it, we will locate the metadata file (likely named something like `metadata.json` in the output directory) and return its path as the final answer.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_5/consolidated_polymorphs.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_5/nitride_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
